body.name: \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm m,I}\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal G_{\mathrm m,I}=((V\times L)\cup\{y\},\,\bigcup_{\ell\in L}\{((u,\ell),(v,\ell)):(u,v)\in E(\mathcal G_{\ell,I})\}\cup\{(y,(i,\ell)):i\in\Delta(\mathbf G,\boldsymbol\kappa)\setminus I,\ \ell\in L\})\); thus intervention removes both component edges entering \(I\) and selector edges entering barred copies of \(I\).
